name_en: Global: Omegaverse fan fiction found in AI writing tool Sudowrite (built on OpenAI models)
description: 2023 entdeckten Fanfiction-Autor:innen, dass das KI-Schreibtool Sudowrite spezifische Tropen des 'Omegaverse'-Genres reproduzierte - ein Stil, der primär auf der Plattform Archive of Our Own (AO3) entstand. Da Sudowrite auf OpenAI-Modellen basiert, galt dies als Beleg, dass urheberrechtlich problematische, nicht-eingewilligte Fanfiction ins Training geflossen war. Als Protest fluteten Autor:innen AO3 mit Omegaverse-Texten ('Knot in my Name'); viele schlossen ihre Werke für nicht registrierte Leser:innen.

description_en: In 2023, fan-fiction writers discovered that the AI writing tool Sudowrite reproduced specific tropes of the 'Omegaverse' genre - a style that originated primarily on the Archive of Our Own (AO3) platform. Because Sudowrite is built on OpenAI models, this was seen as evidence that copyright-sensitive, non-consensual fan fiction had entered the training data. In protest, writers flooded AO3 with Omegaverse texts ('Knot in my Name'); many locked their works to registered readers.
